# Thermal Analysis of GMAW Welding Process on Mild Steel (AISI 1018 / S235)

#   3. Temperature Frequency Distribution — Histogram at each sensor
#   4. Welding Distortions                — Thermal strain & transverse displacement

#
# + Summary Report printed at the end.
#
# ⚠ Prerequisites: Run Tabs 1–4 first.

import numpy as np
import pickle
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
from pathlib import Path
from weldx import WeldxFile, Q_
 
# Load core WeldX file
with WeldxFile(CORE_FILE, mode='r') as wx:
    core = wx.copy()
 
# Load Monte Carlo parameters
with open(MC_FILE, 'rb') as f:
    mc = pickle.load(f)
 
# Load simulation results
with open(RESULTS_FILE, 'rb') as f:
    res = pickle.load(f)
 
# Unpack results
N                = res['n_samples']
t_array          = res['t_array']
sensor_labels    = res['sensor_labels']
sensor_dist_mm   = res['sensor_distances_mm']
thermal_res      = res['thermal_results']
nominal_cycles   = res['nominal_cycles']
peak_temps       = res['peak_temperatures']
mat              = res['material']
 
sample_idx = np.arange(1, N + 1)
 
print(f'[Tab 5] ✓ Loaded Monte Carlo results (Mild Steel GMAW Butt Joint)')
print(f'         Samples    : {N}')
print(f'         Sensors    : {sensor_labels}')
print(f'         Time steps : {len(t_array)}')

# Cell 3 — Plot 1: Current & Voltage vs. Sample Number
# ----------------------------------------------------------
In [7]:
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 8), sharex=True)
fig.suptitle(
    'Plot 1: Current & Voltage across Monte Carlo Samples\n'
    'GMAW Welding on Mild Steel AISI 1018 / S235 (Butt Joint)',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold'
)
 
# Current
current = np.array(mc['current'])
ax1.plot(sample_idx, current, 'o-', color='tomato',
         markersize=4, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.8, label='MC Current [A]')
ax1.axhline(mc['nominal_current'], color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
            label=f'Nominal: {mc["nominal_current"]:.1f} A')
ax1.fill_between(
    sample_idx,
    mc['nominal_current'] - 2*np.std(current),
    mc['nominal_current'] + 2*np.std(current),
    alpha=0.15, color='tomato', label='±2σ band'
)
ax1.set_ylabel('Current [A]', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Welding Current (Monte Carlo Variability)', fontsize=11)
ax1.legend(fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
# Voltage
voltage = np.array(mc['voltage'])
ax2.plot(sample_idx, voltage, 's-', color='royalblue',
         markersize=4, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.8, label='MC Voltage [V]')
ax2.axhline(mc['nominal_voltage'], color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
            label=f'Nominal: {mc["nominal_voltage"]:.1f} V')
ax2.fill_between(
    sample_idx,
    mc['nominal_voltage'] - 2*np.std(voltage),
    mc['nominal_voltage'] + 2*np.std(voltage),
    alpha=0.15, color='royalblue', label='±2σ band'
)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sample Number', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Voltage [V]', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Arc Voltage (Monte Carlo Variability)', fontsize=11)
ax2.legend(fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plot1_current_voltage_gmaw.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('[Tab 5] ✓ Plot 1 saved as plot1_current_voltage_gmaw.png')

# Cell 4 — Plot 2: Sensor Peak Temperature vs. Sample Number
# ----------------------------------------------------------
In [9]:
colors = ['royalblue', 'tomato', 'forestgreen']
 
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(12, 10), sharex=True)
fig.suptitle(
    f'Plot 2: Sensor Peak Temperature vs Sample Number\n'
    f'Monte Carlo Variation — Mild Steel GMAW Butt Joint (N={N})',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold'
)
 
for ax, label, color, d_mm in zip(axes, sensor_labels, colors, sensor_dist_mm):
    T_peak = np.array(peak_temps[label])
    T_mean = T_peak.mean()
    T_std  = T_peak.std()
 
    ax.plot(sample_idx, T_peak, 'o-', color=color,
            markersize=4, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.8, label='Peak Temperature [°C]')
    ax.axhline(T_mean, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
               label=f'Mean = {T_mean:.1f} °C')
    ax.fill_between(sample_idx, T_mean - T_std, T_mean + T_std,
                    alpha=0.2, color=color, label=f'±1σ = ±{T_std:.1f} °C')
 
    ax.set_ylabel('Peak Temperature [°C]', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_title(f'Sensor: {label} (y = {d_mm:.0f} mm from weld centerline)',
                 fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
axes[-1].set_xlabel('Sample Number', fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plot2_sensor_vs_sample_gmaw.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('[Tab 5] ✓ Plot 2 saved as plot2_sensor_vs_sample_gmaw.png')

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))
fig.suptitle(
    f'Plot 3: Peak Temperature Frequency Distribution\n'
    f'Rosenthal Model — GMAW Mild Steel — N={N} Samples',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold'
)
 
for ax, label, color, d_mm in zip(axes, sensor_labels, colors, sensor_dist_mm):
    T_peak = np.array(peak_temps[label])
    T_mean = T_peak.mean()
    T_std  = T_peak.std()
 
    ax.hist(T_peak, bins=15, color=color, alpha=0.75,
            edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.7)
    ax.axvline(T_mean, color='black', linestyle='-', linewidth=2,
               label=f'Mean = {T_mean:.1f} °C')
    ax.axvline(T_mean - T_std, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5,
               label=f'±1σ = {T_std:.1f} °C')
    ax.axvline(T_mean + T_std, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5)
 
    ax.set_xlabel('Peak Temperature [°C]', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
    ax.set_title(f'Sensor: {label}\n(y = {d_mm:.0f} mm from weld centerline)',
                 fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plot3_temp_frequency_gmaw.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('[Tab 5] ✓ Plot 3 saved as plot3_temp_frequency_gmaw.png')

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Cell 6 — Plot 4: Welding Distortions — Estimated Thermal Strain
# ----------------------------------------------------------
In [19]:
# Linear thermal expansion:  ε_th = α_T * ΔT
# Transverse displacement:   δ ≈ α_T * ΔT_mean * (d_sensor / 2)
#
# CTE for Mild Steel = 12e-6 /°C
 
CTE       = 12.0e-6    # Mild Steel coefficient of thermal expansion [/°C]
T_ambient = 25.0       # °C
 
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle(
    'Plot 4: Thermal Strain & Distortion Analysis\n'
    'GMAW Welding on Mild Steel Butt Joint (Rosenthal + Monte Carlo)',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold'
)
 
# ---- (a) Thermal strain vs time (nominal) ----
ax = axes[0, 0]
for label, color, d_mm in zip(sensor_labels, colors, sensor_dist_mm):
    T_nom   = np.array(nominal_cycles[label])
    delta_T = np.maximum(T_nom - T_ambient, 0)
    epsilon = CTE * delta_T * 1e6   # microstrain [μm/m]
    ax.plot(t_array, epsilon, color=color, linewidth=2,
            label=f'{label} ({d_mm:.0f} mm)')
 
ax.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle=':', linewidth=1, label='Torch at sensor')
ax.set_xlabel('Time [s]')
ax.set_ylabel('Thermal Strain [μm/m]')
ax.set_title('(a) Thermal Strain vs Time (Nominal)', fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
# ---- (b) Peak strain (MC) — closest sensor ----
ax     = axes[0, 1]
label0 = sensor_labels[0]
T_peak_mc    = np.array(peak_temps[label0])
epsilon_peak = CTE * np.maximum(T_peak_mc - T_ambient, 0) * 1e6
 
ax.plot(sample_idx, epsilon_peak, 'o-', color='royalblue',
        markersize=4, alpha=0.8)
ax.axhline(epsilon_peak.mean(), color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
           label=f'Mean = {epsilon_peak.mean():.0f} μm/m')
ax.set_xlabel('Sample Number')
ax.set_ylabel('Peak Thermal Strain [μm/m]')
ax.set_title(f'(b) Peak Strain — {label0}', fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
# ---- (c) Transverse distortion estimate (bar chart) ----
ax        = axes[1, 0]
d_values  = sensor_dist_mm * 1e-3   # m
disp_mean, disp_std = [], []
 
for label, d_m in zip(sensor_labels, d_values):
    T_pk  = np.array(peak_temps[label])
    delta = CTE * np.maximum(T_pk - T_ambient, 0) * d_m * 1e3   # [mm]
    disp_mean.append(delta.mean())
    disp_std.append(delta.std())
 
x = np.arange(len(sensor_labels))
ax.bar(x, disp_mean, color=colors, alpha=0.75, edgecolor='black')
ax.errorbar(x, disp_mean, yerr=disp_std,
            fmt='none', color='black', capsize=6)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([f'{l}\n({d:.0f}mm)'
                    for l, d in zip(sensor_labels, sensor_dist_mm)])
ax.set_ylabel('Transverse Displacement [mm]')
ax.set_title('(c) Estimated Distortion per Sensor', fontweight='bold')
ax.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)
 
# ---- (d) Lateral temperature profile (Rosenthal) ----
ax     = axes[1, 1]
Q_nom  = float(core['process']['net_power'].to('W').m)
v_nom  = float(core['process']['speed'].to('m/s').m)
k_val  = mat['k']
alpha_val = mat['alpha']
T0_val    = T_ambient
T_mp_val  = mat['T_mp']
 
y = np.linspace(0.001, 0.040, 300)   # 1mm to 40mm
R = np.maximum(np.abs(y), 3e-3)
T_lat = T0_val + (Q_nom / (2 * np.pi * k_val * R)) * \
        np.exp(-v_nom * R / (2 * alpha_val))
T_lat = np.minimum(T_lat, T_mp_val)
 
ax.plot(y * 1000, T_lat, 'k-', linewidth=2.5, label='Rosenthal profile')
 
for label, color, d_mm in zip(sensor_labels, colors, sensor_dist_mm):
    T_peak_nom = nominal_cycles[label].max()
    ax.axvline(d_mm, color=color, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5)
    ax.plot(d_mm, T_peak_nom, 'D', color=color, markersize=9,
            label=f'{label}: {T_peak_nom:.0f}°C')
 
ax.axhline(T_mp_val, color='red', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.5,
           label='Melting point')
ax.set_xlabel('Distance from Weld [mm]')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature [°C]')
ax.set_title('(d) Lateral Temperature Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plot4_distortion_gmaw.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('[Tab 5] ✓ Plot 4 saved as plot4_distortion_gmaw.png')

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Cell 7 — Plot 5: Torch Speed Travel Plot along Butt Joint
# ----------------------------------------------------------
In [15]:
plate_length_m = float(core['geometry']['plate_length'].to('m').m)
 
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 9))
fig.suptitle(
    f'Plot 5: Torch Travel Analysis — Butt Joint Weld Path\n'
    f'GMAW Welding on Mild Steel — N={N} Monte Carlo Samples',
    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold'
)
 
# ---- (a) Travel speed distribution ----
ax = axes[0, 0]
ax.hist(mc['speed'], bins=15, color='teal', alpha=0.75, edgecolor='black')
ax.axvline(mc['speed'].mean(), color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
           label=f'Mean = {mc["speed"].mean():.3f} mm/s')
ax.set_xlabel('Travel Speed [mm/s]')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax.set_title('(a) Travel Speed Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
# ---- (b) Torch position vs time (MC samples) ----
ax       = axes[0, 1]
selected = np.random.choice(N, size=min(20, N), replace=False)
for i in selected:
    v_i      = mc['speed'][i] * 1e-3   # m/s
    t_travel = np.linspace(0, plate_length_m / v_i, 100)
    x_pos    = -plate_length_m/2 * 1000 + mc['speed'][i] * t_travel
    ax.plot(t_travel, x_pos, color='teal', alpha=0.35, linewidth=1)
 
v_nom_ms = mc['nominal_speed'] * 1e-3
t_nom    = np.linspace(0, plate_length_m / v_nom_ms, 100)
x_nom    = -plate_length_m/2 * 1000 + mc['nominal_speed'] * t_nom
ax.plot(t_nom, x_nom, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2.5, label='Nominal')
ax.axhline(0,  color='red', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7)
ax.set_xlabel('Time [s]')
ax.set_ylabel('Torch Position [mm]')
ax.set_title('(b) Torch Motion vs Time (MC Samples)', fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
# ---- (c) Weld duration distribution ----
ax             = axes[1, 0]
weld_durations = (plate_length_m * 1000) / mc['speed']   # [s]
ax.hist(weld_durations, bins=15, color='darkcyan', alpha=0.75, edgecolor='black')
ax.axvline(weld_durations.mean(), color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
           label=f'Mean = {weld_durations.mean():.1f} s')
ax.set_xlabel('Weld Duration [s]')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax.set_title(f'(c) Weld Duration Distribution\n(Plate length = {plate_length_m*1000:.0f} mm)',
             fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
# ---- (d) Nominal thermal cycles — all sensors ----
ax = axes[1, 1]
for label, color, d_mm in zip(sensor_labels, colors, sensor_dist_mm):
    T_nom = nominal_cycles[label]
    ax.plot(t_array, T_nom, color=color, linewidth=2.5,
            label=f'{label} ({d_mm:.0f} mm)')
 
ax.axvline(0, color='black', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.5, label='Torch at midpoint')
ax.axhline(mat['T_mp'], color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label='Melting point')
ax.set_xlabel('Time [s]')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature [°C]')
ax.set_title('(d) Nominal Thermal Cycles — All Sensors', fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
 
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('plot5_torch_speed_gmaw.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
print('[Tab 5] ✓ Plot 5 saved as plot5_torch_speed_gmaw.png')

print(f'  Density              : {rho:.0f} kg/m³')

print()
 
Q_nom = float(core['process']['net_power'].to('W').m)
v_nom = float(core['process']['speed'].to('m/s').m)
 
print('--- Process: GMAW (Butt Joint) ---')
print(f'  Net Power (nominal)  : {Q_nom:.1f} W')
print(f'  Travel Speed         : {v_nom*1000:.1f} mm/s')

    T_pk = np.array(peak_temps[label])
    print(f'  {label} @ {d_mm:.0f} mm: '
          f'mean={T_pk.mean():.1f}°C, '
          f'std={T_pk.std():.1f}°C, '
          f'min={T_pk.min():.1f}°C, '

]
